LanguageData.MSM_BisectCardText: Mod Sort Manager finds the faulty mod by halving: it disables half of the mods, restarts, and you say whether the problem is still there. About 8 restarts for 200 mods.
LanguageData.MSM_BisectMenuOnly: Available only from the main menu.
LanguageData.MSM_BisectFew: There are not enough mods to test. Libraries that other mods need, DLCs and the game always stay enabled.
LanguageData.MSM_BisectConfirm:
Find the faulty mod
Mod Sort Manager disables half of the {0} suspect mods and restarts the game. After each start, check whether the problem is still there and answer in the small window in the main menu. About {1} restarts.
Libraries that other mods need, DLCs and the game stay enabled. At the end your mod list is restored exactly as it is now.
Important: do not save your colony while testing – with half of the mods missing it could get damaged. Test in a new colony or just watch the errors at startup.

LanguageData.MSM_BisectFoundText: The problem points to this mod. To be sure: disable it – if the problem goes away, it is the one. If not, the problem may need two mods together or comes from a library.
LanguageData.MSM_BisectRunning: Finding the faulty mod is in progress – the list now holds only the tested half. Cancel the search and restore all your mods (restarts the game)?
LanguageData.MSM_BisectMismatch: The game did not start with the mods of this step – a mod probably failed to load and the game fell back, or the list was changed elsewhere. The answer would be wrong. Apply this step again, or cancel.
LanguageData.MSM_BisectNotFound: The search could not finish. Restore all your mods and try again.

LanguageData.MSM_PS_ManyText: If something breaks, it is hard to tell which mod did it. Add them in {0} groups – the next group is offered the next time you open Mod Sort Manager.
LanguageData.MSM_SetPreSaveTip: Before a changed list is saved: missing dependencies, mods for older game versions, many new mods at once and things new mods need that won't exist. Problems that would otherwise only show after the restart.
LanguageData.MSM_RestartTip: Restarts the game without changing the mod list. In a game with “Return to the game after restart” on, the game is saved first and loaded again after the restart.
LanguageData.MSM_SameBlocking: At least one can skip the original code – that can also stop the other mod's change. Check that both still work.
LanguageData.MSM_SameAdditive: Both only rewrite or add to the code – usually fine, a real clash is possible only when the rewrites collide.
LanguageData.MSM_SameLegend: prefix runs before the game's code; a prefix that can skip may stop the game's code and the prefixes after it. postfix runs after it and only adds – it does not conflict. transpiler rewrites the code itself – two of them can collide. "Runs first" = the prefix that decides first.
